description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for policy command strategies within a policy management system. It provides common methods and exception handling for subclasses implementing specific command strategies related to policies.

classes.name: AbstractPolicyCommandStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class providing common logic for policy command strategies, including validation and exception handling.

methods.name: AbstractPolicyCommandStrategy
methods.description: Constructor initializing the strategy with the class type of commands it handles.

methods.name: getValidator
methods.description: Returns the conditional headers validator for policy commands.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Indicates whether the command is defined; always returns true in this base implementation.

methods.name: calculateRelativeMetadata
methods.description: Calculates relative metadata for a policy entity; default implementation returns empty.

methods.name: policyEntryNotFound
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating a policy entry was not found.

methods.name: subjectNotFound
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating a subject was not found.

methods.name: resourceNotFound
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating a resource was not accessible or found.

methods.name: policyNotFound
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating a policy was not accessible.

methods.name: policyInvalid
methods.description: Creates an exception for an invalid or corrupted policy.

methods.name: policyEntryInvalid
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating a policy entry is invalid.
